mechanism: Lopinavir (CYP3A4 inhibitor) may increase minocycline levels; minocycline can cause photosensitivity and potential CNS effects; both drugs metabolized hepatically with potential for altered clearance.
action: Monitor for minocycline toxicity signs (dizziness, vertigo, photosensitivity); counsel on sun protection; consider alternative antibiotic if possible; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical monitoring recommended.
